title: 6C In Dispute — Идиомы: споры и компромиссы

items.example: The landlord and I finally met halfway on the rent.
It took an hour to find common ground.
After the argument, the neighbours buried the hatchet.
She stood her ground and refused to pay for the damage.
I draw the line at paying for someone else's rubbish.
The landlord laid down the law about noisy parties.
He stuck to his guns until they fixed the heating.
Every compromise needs some give and take.
The meeting turned into a war of words.
There has been bad blood between the two flats for years.
A calm talk helped clear the air.
I tried to talk some sense into him about the deposit.
She drove a hard bargain and got two months free.

items.idiom: the ball is in your court
items.example: I have made my offer — the ball is in your court.
Once we shake hands, it is a done deal.
